items.title: Building AI-Aware Controls for Enterprise Risk - with Craig Unger of Hyperproof
items.summary: AI is multiplying the machine identities, unapproved tools, and vendor connections that enterprise risk teams must govern. In this episode, Craig Unger, CEO and Founder at Hyperproof, explains how AI is reshaping enterprise risk and where it can help teams manage it, from scanning for regulatory change to testing entire sets of evidence instead of samples. He also outlines practical steps for leaders: inventory where AI is running and put a governance model around it, automate continuous control monitoring, make existing controls AI-aware, and extend the same scrutiny to vendors. This episode is sponsored by Hyperproof ​ Learn how leading organizations approach AI investment like a venture portfolio and work across teams to identify the right data.
